summary: Bailey, a 100-pound German Shepherd, became immobile and unable to descend after summiting Mt. Hope (~13,600 ft); his owner could not carry him down the class-3 east ridge. Chaffee County SAR North fielded two teams of eight from the Sheep Gulch trailhead ~2:30 p.m., hiked seven miles up the east ridge, located Bailey via a cell-phone ping, and alternated carrying him down in a dog-sling backpack; all ~20 members were out of the field by ~1:15 a.m. July 7 and the owner retrieved Bailey at the SAR bay in Buena Vista.
location: Mt. Hope summit area (~13,600 ft), east ridge, via Sheep Gulch trailhead
notes: ~12-hour mission; CCSAR North notes it does not officially respond for animals but deployed anyway.
